summary:
Podman6.1.4 inspection reports Running only for its running state and Paused separately, while PID and conmon PID come from stored runtime state. A positive reported PID therefore is not equivalent to Running and is not an authenticated live birth. Represent running, paused and stopped explicitly, and report metadata as unverifiable when the selected original PID/start/boot/namespace/cgroup cannot be observed. Do not turn missing old birth evidence into empty coverage, assume a paused object is running, or stop/unpause/remove it merely to make a baseline validate. Fresh isolated work must prove its actual engine storage, runtime and process boundaries instead.

The same inspected source maps HostConfig.Cgroups only from NoCgroups to disabled/default; default is a lossy projection and does not establish no-conmon mode or actual helper placement. Join selected creation argv, actual manager/role cgroups and original identities. A new engine mode must agree across member parent/cgroup flags, callback argv and its pause/namespace proof; tuple construction is not execution or callback settlement.

Keep original execution outcomes and later manager metadata separate. Cleared current MainPID/ExecMain fields or a later empty cgroup cannot reconstruct the missing original receipt. A timely original outcome/retirement receipt can remain valid alongside cleared current fields; missing original-time proof stays Unknown. Current read-only observations can still support demonstrated-independent fresh work under ADR0096 without retroactive success, replay or a global historical hold. These are source-derived observation rules and public review findings, not a new cleanup authority or native qualification.
title: Typed process observations separate reported state from original ownership
